Around 1995/12

blocks.source: ＳＦＣでは後期のＲＰＧ。ＦＦ６よりも、さらに１年半も後の作品だったりする。
blocks.translation: A late-era RPG for the Super Famicom. It was released a full year and a half after FF6.

blocks.source: ＤＳ版のリメイクも存在しており、仲間会話システムが搭載されている。ただし、難易度が低下している他、モンスター仲間システムが削られているらしい。
blocks.translation: A remake for the DS also exists, featuring a party conversation system. However, the difficulty has apparently been lowered, and the monster recruitment system was removed.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Substance / Story

blocks.source: 本作では、二つの世界を行き来しながら冒険することになる。ＤＱ６のストーリーは比較的地味な印象があるけれど、世界設定は凝っている。あまり、ネタバレも何なので細かくは書かないが、二つの世界の関係性にも一応の意外性がある。
blocks.translation: In this game, you go on an adventure while traveling back and forth between two worlds. Although DQ6's story gives a relatively understated impression, its worldbuilding is elaborate. I won't go into detail since I don't want to spoil too much, but there is at least some surprising aspect to the relationship between the two worlds.

blocks.source: ストーリー上の難点として、比較的序盤に魔王ムドーとの決戦という山場を終えてしまうため、以降の展開で中弛みしやすいことが挙げられる。ジャミラスとかグラコスとかデュランとか敵側の幹部関連のイベントがあっさりしているのは、ちともったいない。
blocks.translation: One weakness of the story is that the climactic showdown with the Demon King Mudo is resolved relatively early, making the later developments prone to losing momentum. It's a bit of a shame that the events involving enemy commanders such as Jamirus, Gracos, and Duran are handled so casually.

blocks.source: また、全体的にプレイヤーに対する動機付けが少々乏しいのも気になるところ。
blocks.translation: Another concern is that the game is somewhat lacking in motivation for the player overall.

blocks.source: 『精霊のお告げで旅立て』とか『自分探ししろ』とか、何だか漠然としていて、プレイヤー自身に『～せねば』と感じさせる要素に乏しい。
blocks.translation: Things like “Set out at the spirits' behest” and “Go find yourself” feel rather vague, and there are few elements that make the player personally feel that they “must” do something.

blocks.source: 特に『自分探し』については、主人公の正体がほぼ判明してからの展開となる。例えば、記憶喪失の主人公が自分の正体を探す物語は王道だけど、そういったミステリー要素もないので牽引力に欠ける。
blocks.translation: In particular, the “search for oneself” only becomes part of the plot after the protagonist's identity is nearly revealed. For example, a story in which an amnesiac protagonist searches for their identity is a classic premise, but this game lacks that sort of mystery element, so it doesn't provide much narrative drive.

blocks.source: それでいて、明確な目的が示されない割にストーリー進行は一本道が多く、行ける場所に行けば何となく話が進む。もっとも、これはＤＱ５の時点で徴候があったけれども。
blocks.translation: Even though it doesn't present a clear objective, the story progression is often linear; simply going to an accessible location somehow moves the story forward. That said, there were already signs of this in DQ5.

blocks.source: ＤＱ４や５と比較して、かなり長かった印象があるのだが調べてみると、ダンジョン自体はそれほどでもない。ダンジョン数は２７程度と確かに多いのだが、『川の抜け道』『砂漠の抜け道』といった短いものが多く含まれている。長いと感じるのは、手強いボス戦が多いからだろう。
blocks.translation: I remembered it as being considerably longer than DQ4 and 5, but when I looked into it, the dungeons themselves weren't particularly lengthy. There are indeed around 27 dungeons, which is quite a lot, but many are short areas such as “River Passage” and “Desert Passage.” It probably feels long because there are so many tough boss battles.

blocks.source: シナリオ進行による町人のセリフ変化が多いせいか、文章量が非常に多い。セリフ集を見る限りは、３０万字以上もあるようだが、これはＤＱ５の数倍となる。ただし、メインストーリー上では仲間キャラクターはごく限られた場面でしかセリフを話さない。
blocks.translation: Perhaps because the townspeople's dialogue changes frequently as the scenario progresses, the amount of text is enormous. Judging from the dialogue collection, it seems to exceed 300,000 Japanese characters, several times the amount in DQ5. However, during the main story, party members speak only in very limited situations.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: ＤＱ３以来となる転職システムを搭載。
blocks.translation: Features the class change system, returning for the first time since DQ3.

blocks.source: ＤＱ４のようにストーリー進行に合わせて多数の仲間が登場。
blocks.translation: Like in DQ4, numerous party members appear as the story progresses.

blocks.source: ＤＱ５から引き続きモンスター仲間システムを採用。
blocks.translation: Retains the monster recruitment system from DQ5.

blocks.source: というように、それまでのＤＱシリーズの集大成と言うべき贅沢なシステムとなっている。しかし、それがうまくいっているかというと難しいところ。各システム自体が衝突を起こしてしまって、それぞれの魅力を発揮できていない部分が多く見られる。
blocks.translation: In this way, it is an extravagant system that could be called the culmination of the Dragon Quest series up to that point. However, whether it actually works well is another matter. The systems themselves often clash, and there are many areas where they fail to show their individual appeal.

blocks.source: 例えば……
blocks.translation: For example…

blocks.source: 呪文・特技の習得が職業にほぼ依存しているため、キャラ毎の特性が薄まっている。
blocks.translation: Because learning spells and Techs depends almost entirely on one's class, each character's individual traits are diminished.

blocks.source: 後半、仲間になったキャラは職業熟練度が低く、使いにくい。
blocks.translation: Characters who join in the latter half have low class proficiency, making them difficult to use.

blocks.source: せっかく、モンスターを仲間にしても人間の仲間で事足りる。
blocks.translation: Even if you go to the trouble of recruiting monsters, human party members are sufficient.

blocks.source: というように、『色々盛り込んだけど、うまくいかなかったシステム』の代表として挙げられることも多い。
blocks.translation: As such, it is often cited as a prime example of a “system that included all kinds of things but didn't work well.”

blocks.source: 僕の長年のゲーム制作経験から見て、この種の『ごった煮系システム』の問題を指摘すると、それは制作に掛けた手間に見合った成果を得にくいこと。２年掛けて色々と盛り込んだゲームシステムが、半年で作ったシンプルなゲームシステムと大差ない評判だったり、それどころかむしろ劣る。なんて憂き目を見やすい。これは制作者としては、結構悲しいことなので気をつけたいと常々思う。
blocks.translation: Based on my many years of experience making games, the problem with this kind of “everything-but-the-kitchen-sink system” is that it is difficult to achieve results commensurate with the effort put into development. A game system packed with all sorts of features over two years can end up receiving a reputation not much different from that of a simple system made in six months—or even a worse one. That is the kind of misfortune it is prone to. As a creator, I find that quite sad, so I always try to keep it in mind.

blocks.source: ゲーム序盤、魔王ムドーを倒すまでは転職システム（及びそれに付属するモンスター仲間システム）が解禁されない。それまでは、シンプルな進行となるのだが、ゲームバランスとしては、むしろこの部分を評価する人が多い。特に難関となる魔王ムドーとの戦いの評価が高い。
blocks.translation: At the beginning of the game, the class change system (along with its associated monster recruitment system) remains locked until you defeat the Demon King Mudo. Until then, progression is simple, but many people actually praise this part in terms of game balance. The battle against the formidable Demon King Mudo in particular is highly regarded.

blocks.source: で、転職システムが解禁されると同時にゲームバランスも大きく変化する。ＤＱ６の転職システムはＤＱ３とは異なり、転職してもレベルは下がらない。レベルはそのまま、職業に沿った能力補正が掛かるというもので、ＦＦ５のジョブアビリティシステムに酷似している。ただし、ＤＱ６の場合「一度覚えた呪文・特技は他の職業になっても制限なく使用できる」という点で異なる。
blocks.translation: Then, as soon as the class change system is unlocked, the game balance changes dramatically as well. Unlike DQ3, DQ6's class change system does not reduce your level when you change classes. Your level remains the same, while your abilities receive modifiers based on your class, making it very similar to FF5's job ability system. However, DQ6 differs in that “spells and Techs learned once can be used without restriction even after changing to another class.”

blocks.source: 職業間のバランス調整にはかなり難あり。特に武闘家は『まわしげり』『せいけんづき』『ばくれつけん』など、ＭＰを消費しないで使える強力な特技を多く持っている。『まわしげり』など、複数の敵に攻撃できる技はブーメランやムチといった複数攻撃武器や複数攻撃呪文の存在価値を大きく奪ってしまっている。
blocks.translation: The balance between classes is quite poorly adjusted. Martial Artists in particular have many powerful Techs that can be used without consuming MP, such as “Roundhouse Kick,” “Miracle Strike,” and “Berserk.” Techniques such as “Roundhouse Kick,” which can attack multiple enemies, greatly diminish the value of multi-target weapons such as boomerangs and whips, as well as multi-target attack spells.

blocks.source: このように転職システムの恩恵によって、劇的に強くなる楽しみはあるのだが、戦闘が単調になってしまう傾向がある。
blocks.translation: Thus, while the class change system offers the enjoyment of becoming dramatically stronger, it also tends to make battles monotonous.

blocks.source: また、職業による能力補正も問題あり。例えば、魔法使いは最大ＨＰが大きく下がるのだが、バーバラのような元々、ＨＰの低いキャラクターを魔法使いに転職させると、その特徴がさらに際立つ。あまりにもＨＰが低くなって、まともに戦闘に使えなくなってしまう。
blocks.translation: The ability modifiers provided by classes are also problematic. For example, Mages suffer a significant reduction in maximum HP, so changing an originally low-HP character like Barbara into a Mage makes that trait even more pronounced. Her HP becomes so low that she can no longer be used effectively in battle.

blocks.source: 呪文の弱体化も甚だしい。多くの特技が攻撃力の上昇に比例して、威力も上昇するように設定されているのに対して、呪文は与えられるダメージが固定されている。ＦＦのように弱点を付けば大ダメージを与えるという要素も薄い。特技の多くは消費ＭＰが存在しない。
blocks.translation: The weakening of spells is also extreme. While many Techs are designed to increase in power in proportion to rising attack power, the damage dealt by spells is fixed. There is also little of the FF-style element where hitting a weakness deals massive damage. Many Techs have no MP cost.

blocks.source: 職業間のバランスだけではなく、単純にキャラクター間の強さのバランスにも問題あり。呪文・特技はほぼ職業に依存する分、能力値でキャラの個性化を図る必要があるわけだけど、どうもその調整がまずい。
blocks.translation: There are problems not only with the balance between classes, but also with the simple balance of strength between characters. Since spells and Techs depend almost entirely on classes, characters need to be differentiated through their stats, but that adjustment seems poorly handled.

blocks.source: 特によく言われるのは、後半に仲間となるテリーが強くないということ。ストーリー上でさんざん期待させた分、落差が酷い。強くないという以前に、チャモロと能力的な差異に乏しく、今ひとつ差別化ができていないのが難点。
blocks.translation: The most commonly cited example is that Terry, who joins in the latter half, is not very strong. After all the expectations built up for him in the story, the discrepancy is severe. Even beyond his lack of strength, he has little difference in abilities from Chamoro, making it difficult to differentiate him effectively.

blocks.source: ゲームシステム上、ＨＰや力の高いキャラが有利で、プレイヤーが使用するキャラも偏りやすい。最終的に主人公、ハッサン、ドランゴ、アモス辺りを一軍に固定した人が多いはず。強いけど、いかつい。
blocks.translation: The game system favors characters with high HP and Strength, making players likely to rely on a narrow selection of characters. Many players probably ended up keeping the Hero, Hassan, Drango, and Amos fixed in their main party. They're strong, but intimidating.

blocks.source: そんなわけで、この作品こそ、ＤＱ９で導入された『攻撃魔力』『回復魔力』のようなパラメータがあれば、良かったのではないだろうか。
blocks.translation: For that reason, this is precisely the kind of game that might have benefited from parameters like “Magical Might” and “Magical Mending,” introduced in DQ9.

blocks.source: バーバラ：攻撃型魔法使い
blocks.translation: Barbara: Offensive Mage

blocks.source: チャモロ：回復型魔法使い
blocks.translation: Chamoro: Healing Mage

blocks.source: ミレーユ：バランス型魔法使い
blocks.translation: Mireille: Balanced Mage

blocks.source: テリー ：魔法戦士
blocks.translation: Terry : Magic Warrior

blocks.source: という感じで、差別化できそうだけど、どうでしょう。
blocks.translation: That sort of setup could have differentiated them, but what do you think?

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ後期だけあってドット絵は綺麗。モンスターが行動の度にアニメーションをするようになったのは、この作品から。これより後にＤＱ３のリメイクがあって、さすがにそちらには劣るが、それでもＤＱ５と比較すると一目瞭然でグラフィックの質が向上している。ただし、モンスターデザイン自体の評価はＤＱ３、４辺りと比較すると劣るかも。
blocks.translation: As expected from a late-period SNES title, the pixel art is beautiful. This was the first game in the series in which monsters began animating each time they took an action. A remake of DQ3 was released after this, and this game naturally falls short of it, but even so, compared with DQ5, the improvement in graphic quality is immediately obvious. However, the monster designs themselves may not be rated as highly when compared with those in DQ3 and DQ4.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 曲調が今までの作品と比較すると、地味目かもしれない。特に戦闘やフィールド曲の評価はそれまでの作品と比較して一歩劣る。戦闘曲では、演出もあってムドー戦のものが最も評価が高い。
blocks.translation: Compared with the music in previous games, the overall style may be somewhat subdued. In particular, the battle and field music falls a step short of that in earlier titles. Among the battle tracks, the one for the battle against Mudo is rated the highest, partly because of its presentation.

blocks.source: なんだかんだ言いながら、町やダンジョンの曲はなかなか多彩。目立つところに良曲は少ないのだけど、全体としては悪くない水準を維持している。
blocks.translation: Despite everything, the town and dungeon tracks are quite varied. There are few standout tracks that are especially good, but overall, the music maintains a decent level of quality.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 全体的には水準以上だし、ＳＦＣのＲＰＧの中では、かなり遊びやすい部類でもある。マイナーＲＰＧの類と比較すれば、完成度には雲泥の差がある。
blocks.translation: Overall, it is above average, and among SNES RPGs, it is also quite easy to play. Compared with lesser-known RPGs, there is a world of difference in terms of polish.

blocks.source: その割に、何だか思い付いたことを好きに書いていたら、不満点ばかりが目立ってしまった。僕に限らず、この作品はストーリー・システム・バランスに付いては「ああすれば良かった」「こうすれば良かった」と言われることが多く、つまりはもったいない作品なのかもしれない。
blocks.translation: Despite that, when I freely wrote down whatever came to mind, the points I disliked ended up standing out. Not just in my opinion, this game is often described in terms of its story, systems, and balance as something that “should have done this” or “should have done that.” In other words, it may be a game with a lot of unrealized potential.

blocks.source: 色々と書いたのは、そんなＤＱ６に付いて、何が足りないのかを考察することが、ゲーム制作者として有意義だと思った次第。
blocks.translation: The reason I wrote all this was that I thought considering what DQ6 lacks would be meaningful to me as a game developer.

texts.また、職業による能力補正も問題あり。例えば、魔法使いは最大ＨＰが大きく下がるのだ: The ability modifiers provided by classes are also problematic. For example, Mages suffer a significant reduction in maximum HP, so changing an originally low-HP character like Barbara into a Mage makes that trait even more pronounced. Her HP becomes so low that she can no longer be used effectively in battle.
texts.呪文の弱体化も甚だしい。多くの特技が攻撃力の上昇に比例して、威力も上昇するように: The weakening of spells is also extreme. While many Techs are designed to increase in power in proportion to rising attack power, the damage dealt by spells is fixed. There is also little of the FF-style element where hitting a weakness deals massive damage. Many Techs have no MP cost.
texts.職業間のバランスだけではなく、単純にキャラクター間の強さのバランスにも問題あり。: There are problems not only with the balance between classes, but also with the simple balance of strength between characters. Since spells and Techs depend almost entirely on classes, characters need to be differentiated through their stats, but that adjustment seems poorly handled.
texts.特によく言われるのは、後半に仲間となるテリーが強くないということ。ストーリー上で: The most commonly cited example is that Terry, who joins in the latter half, is not very strong. After all the expectations built up for him in the story, the discrepancy is severe. Even beyond his lack of strength, he has little difference in abilities from Chamoro, making it difficult to differentiate him effectively.
texts.ゲームシステム上、ＨＰや力の高いキャラが有利で、プレイヤーが使用するキャラも偏り: The game system favors characters with high HP and Strength, making players likely to rely on a narrow selection of characters. Many players probably ended up keeping the Hero, Hassan, Drango, and Amos fixed in their main party. They're strong, but intimidating.
texts.そんなわけで、この作品こそ、ＤＱ９で導入された『攻撃魔力』『回復魔力』のようなパ: For that reason, this is precisely the kind of game that might have benefited from parameters like “Magical Might” and “Magical Mending,” introduced in DQ9.
texts.という感じで、差別化できそうだけど、どうでしょう。: That sort of setup could have differentiated them, but what do you think?
texts.ＳＦＣ後期だけあってドット絵は綺麗。モンスターが行動の度にアニメーションをするよ: As expected from a late-period SNES title, the pixel art is beautiful. This was the first game in the series in which monsters began animating each time they took an action. A remake of DQ3 was released after this, and this game naturally falls short of it, but even so, compared with DQ5, the improvement in graphic quality is immediately obvious. However, the monster designs themselves may not be rated as highly when compared with those in DQ3 and DQ4.
texts.曲調が今までの作品と比較すると、地味目かもしれない。特に戦闘やフィールド曲の評価: Compared with the music in previous games, the overall style may be somewhat subdued. In particular, the battle and field music falls a step short of that in earlier titles. Among the battle tracks, the one for the battle against Mudo is rated the highest, partly because of its presentation.
texts.なんだかんだ言いながら、町やダンジョンの曲はなかなか多彩。目立つところに良曲は少: Despite everything, the town and dungeon tracks are quite varied. There are few standout tracks that are especially good, but overall, the music maintains a decent level of quality.
texts.全体的には水準以上だし、ＳＦＣのＲＰＧの中では、かなり遊びやすい部類でもある。マ: Overall, it is above average, and among SNES RPGs, it is also quite easy to play. Compared with lesser-known RPGs, there is a world of difference in terms of polish.
texts.その割に、何だか思い付いたことを好きに書いていたら、不満点ばかりが目立ってしまっ: Despite that, when I freely wrote down whatever came to mind, the points I disliked ended up standing out. Not just in my opinion, this game is often described in terms of its story, systems, and balance as something that “should have done this” or “should have done that.” In other words, it may be a game with a lot of unrealized potential.
texts.色々と書いたのは、そんなＤＱ６に付いて、何が足りないのかを考察することが、ゲーム: The reason I wrote all this was that I thought considering what DQ6 lacks would be meaningful to me as a game developer.
